report.summary: For 2026, hands-on testing converges on a few standouts: Breville Combi Wave 3-in-1 as the most capable combo unit, Panasonic NN-SN686S as the best pure microwave for most people, LG NeoChef 1.5 cu ft for large capacity simplicity, and GE 1.0 cu ft Convection + Air Fry as the budget combo. Wirecutter and RTINGS lab tests corroborate Panasonic and Breville for even heating.

products.name: Breville Combi Wave 3-in-1 BMO870
pros: Intuitive to use with simple on-screen instructions per hands-on Bon Appetit testing
Powerful unit with small footprint for a combo microwave/convection/air fryer
Versatile cooking options - microwave, air fry, convection in one
Consistently top-rated in RTINGS and Bon Appetit hands-on tests for even heating
cons: High price point for its small-sized unit - $500 at Amazon/Breville per Bon Appetit
Learning curve for combo modes vs simple microwave
products.verdict: Best overall countertop pick if you want one appliance to do three jobs. Hands-on testing by Bon Appetit confirms it's intuitive and powerful despite premium price and smaller cavity.

pros: Inverter Technology provides true low-power for even defrosting without hot edges
Genius Sensor automatically adjusts time/power based on humidity
Wirecutter Jan 2026 lab pick: stands out for even heating and useful features
Community consensus: Reddit BuyItForLifeUSA calls it best microwave 2026 crown at ~$130 outperforming twice-price units
cons: No convection or air fry - microwave only
Stainless finish shows fingerprints, basic design
products.verdict: The first microwave you should buy per hands-on Bon Appetit testing, and Wirecutter's top pick for even heating. If you don't need air fry, this is the reliable, well-tested value king.

products.name: LG 1.5 cu. ft. NeoChef Countertop Microwave with Smart Inverter and Sensor Cooking

cons: LG microwaves have community reports of uneven heating and warranty complaints per SlashGear June 2026

products.verdict: Best large-capacity simple microwave per hands-on Bon Appetit. Good if you prioritize interior space over combo features, but check warranty terms given mixed long-term reliability chatter.
